subject: maths
title: Year 2 Calendars and Dates
seo_title: Year 2 Calendar Worksheets: Days, Months, Dates and Seasons (Free, with Answer Key)
standard_text: Identify the date and determine the number of days between events using calendars
meta_desc: Free Year 2 maths worksheets on calendars for the Australian Curriculum (AC9M2M03): days of the week and months in order, reading a month calendar, finding next Tuesday, counting the days between events and Australian seasons and school holidays. 100 questions with an answer key.
key_big: Count the jumps, not the boxes: do not count today.
key_sub: Each row of a calendar is 1 week. From 3 September to 10 September is 10 − 3 = 7 days. In Australia summer is December to February and winter is June to August.
body_html:
Days and months in order

A week has 7 days. A year has 12 months. Say them in order every day.

In order
Days (7)Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday
Months (12)January, February, March, April, May, June, July, August, September, October, November, December

After Sunday a new week starts. After December a new year starts.

Reading a calendar

Each row is 1 week. Each column is one day of the week. Find the date, then go up to the top to see the day.

Next Tuesday

Today is Wednesday 9 June. What is the date of the next Tuesday?

Go forward from 9 to the next date in the Tue column.

Answer: 15 June

How many days between?

Count the jumps, not the boxes. Do not count today: no time has passed yet. You can also take away: later date − earlier date.

Sports day

Today is 3 September. Sports day is 10 September. How many days until sports day?

Jumps: 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10. That is 7 jumps. Or 10 − 3 = 7.

Answer: 7 days

A birthday

Today is 14 September. Kai’s party is on 18 September. How many sleeps?

18 − 14 = 4. The sleeps are the nights of 14, 15, 16 and 17 September.

Answer: 4 sleeps

Seasons in Australia

Australia is in the south of the world. Our seasons are the opposite of England and the USA. Christmas is in summer here.

Australian schools have 4 terms. The long summer holidays are in December and January.

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Counting today: 3 to 10 September is 8 daysCount the jumps: 10 − 3 = 7 days
Months out of order: May, July, JuneSay them in order: May, June, July
After December comes “13th month”After December a new year starts: January
July is summerIn Australia July is winter. Summer is December to February
Every month starts on MondayLook at the calendar: 1 May 2027 is a Saturday

faq.q: What do Year 2 students learn about calendars in Australia?
faq.a: In the Australian Curriculum v9.0 (AC9M2M03), Year 2 students find the date on a calendar and work out the number of days between events, such as from today to a birthday or sports day.

faq.q: How do you count the days between two dates?
faq.a: Count the jumps from one date to the next, not the boxes, and do not count the start day. From 3 September to 10 September is 10 − 3 = 7 days.

faq.q: What are the seasons in Australia?
faq.a: Summer is December, January and February; autumn is March to May; winter is June to August; spring is September to November. They are the opposite of the seasons in Europe and North America.

faq.q: How can I help my child learn the days and months?
faq.a: Keep a calendar on the fridge, cross off each day and count the sleeps to birthdays and holidays together. Say the days and months in order, and talk about which season each month is in.

sets.title: Days of the week and months of the year in order

items.q: Which day comes after Monday?
items.e: Say the days in order: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday … So Tuesday comes after Monday. (Sunday comes before Monday.)

items.q: Which day comes before Friday?
items.e: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday. Thursday is just before Friday. (Saturday comes after Friday.)

items.q: How many days are in 1 week?
items.e: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday. That is 7 days. (5 is only the school days. 12 is the number of months.)

items.q: Which day is missing?
items.e: Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday. Wednesday is the day between Tuesday and Thursday.

items.q: Which day comes after Sunday?
items.e: Sunday is the last day on the calendar. Then a new week starts with Monday.

items.q: Which two days are the weekend?
items.e: There is no school on the weekend: Saturday and Sunday. School is Monday to Friday.

items.q: Today is Thursday. What day was it yesterday?
items.e: Yesterday is the day before. The day before Thursday is Wednesday. (Friday is tomorrow.)

items.q: How many months are in 1 year?
items.e: January to December: 12 months. (7 is the days in a week, 52 is the weeks in a year and 4 is the seasons.)

items.q: What is the first month of the year?
items.e: The year starts on 1 January. January is first. December is the last month.

items.q: Which month comes after March?
items.e: January, February, March, April, May … April comes after March. (February comes before it.)

items.q: Which month comes before October?
items.e: … August, September, October, November … September is just before October.

items.q: Which month comes after December?
items.e: December is the last month. Then a new year starts with January.

items.q: Which month is missing?
items.e: Jan, Feb, Mar, Apr, May, Jun, Jul, Aug … The missing month is July. (June and August are next to it.)

items.q: Which month is missing?
items.e: Sep, Oct, Nov, Dec. The missing month is November. It is the 11th month.

items.q: Today is Friday. What day will it be in 2 days?
items.e: Count on 2 days from Friday: Saturday (1), Sunday (2). It will be Sunday. (Saturday is only 1 day. Do not count Friday.)

items.q: What is the 5th month of the year?
items.e: January (1st), February (2nd), March (3rd), April (4th), May (5th).

items.q: Which list of days is in order?
items.e: The days go Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday … The other lists mix them up.

items.q: Which list of months is in order?
items.e: The months go April, May, June, July, August … The other lists mix them up.

items.q: Today is Tuesday. What day was it 3 days ago?
items.e: Count back 3 days from Tuesday: Monday (1), Sunday (2), Saturday (3). It was Saturday. (Sunday counts Tuesday as one of the days. Friday counts on, not back.)

items.q: Which month is 2 months after November?
items.e: Count on from November: December (1), January (2). After December the year starts again, so it is January. (September is 2 months before.)

items.q: Which month does this calendar show?
items.e: The month is at the top of the calendar: May 2027. (Monday is a day, not a month.)

items.q: How many days are in May?
items.e: The last date is 31, so May has 31 days. (7 is the days in one row. 6 is the number of rows.)

items.q: What day of the week is 1 May?
items.e: Find 1 and go up its column to the top: Sat. 1 May is a Saturday. (A month does not always start on Monday.)

items.q: What day of the week is 12 May?
items.e: Find 12 and go up its column to the top: Wednesday.

items.q: What date comes just after 19 May?
items.e: The next date is one more: 19 + 1 = 20 May. (26 May is the date under it, one week later.)

items.q: What date comes just before 10 May?
items.e: The date before is one less: 10 − 1 = 9 May. On the calendar, 9 is at the end of the row above. (3 May is the date above 10, one week earlier.)

items.q: What day of the week is 31 May?
items.e: 31 is on its own row, in the Mon column. 31 May is a Monday.

items.q: Isla’s birthday is circled. What is the date?
items.e: The circle is around 18. Isla’s birthday is 18 August.

items.q: What day of the week is 20 May?
items.e: Find 20 and go up its column to the top: Thursday.

items.q: What day of the week is Isla’s birthday?
items.e: Go up from the circled 18 to the top of its column: Wednesday.

items.q: What is the date of the first Monday in May?
items.e: Go down the Mon column. The first number is 3. So it is 3 May. (1 May is the first date, but it is a Saturday.)

items.q: Sports day is in the green box. What day of the week is it?
items.e: Go up from 6 to the top of its column: Friday. So sports day is Friday 6 August.

items.q: What is the date of the last Wednesday in May?
items.e: Go down the Wed column to the bottom: 5, 12, 19, 26. The last one is 26 May. (31 May is the last date, but it is a Monday.)

items.q: How many Sundays are in May 2027?
items.e: The Sundays are 2, 9, 16, 23, 30. That is 5 Sundays. (30 is the last Sunday’s date.)

items.q: What is the date of the second Friday in May?
items.e: The Fridays are 7, 14, 21, 28. The second one is 14 May. (7 May is the first Friday.)

items.q: Which date is a Saturday?
items.e: Look in the Sat column: 1, 8, 15, 22, 29. So 15 May is a Saturday. (14 May is a Friday and 16 May is a Sunday.)

items.q: How many Mondays are in August 2027?
items.e: The Mondays are 2, 9, 16, 23, 30. That is 5 Mondays. (30 is the date of the last one.)

items.q: What is the date of the last day of August?
items.e: The last number on the calendar is 31. So the last day is 31 August. (August has 31 days, not 30.)

items.q: What day of the week will 1 September be?
items.e: 31 August is a Tuesday. 1 September is the next day, so it is a Wednesday. (A new month does not always start on Monday.)

items.q: What day of the week was 31 July?
items.e: 1 August is a Sunday. 31 July is the day before, so it was a Saturday.

sets.title: Tomorrow, next Tuesday and 1 week later

items.q: Today is Wednesday 9 June. What is the date tomorrow?
items.e: Tomorrow is the next day: 9 + 1 = 10 June. (8 June was yesterday.)

items.q: Today is Wednesday 9 June. What was the date yesterday?
items.e: Yesterday is the day before: 9 − 1 = 8 June. (10 June is tomorrow.)

items.q: Today is Friday 15 October. What day of the week will it be tomorrow?
items.e: The day after Friday is Saturday. (Thursday was yesterday.)

items.q: Today is Wednesday 9 June. What day of the week will it be in 3 days?
items.e: Count on from Wednesday: Thursday (1), Friday (2), Saturday (3). It will be Saturday. (Friday counts Wednesday as day 1.)

items.q: Today is Wednesday 9 June. What is the date 1 week from today?
items.e: 1 week = 7 days. 9 + 7 = 16. Go straight down one row: 16 June. (15 June counts today as one of the 7 days.)

items.q: Today is Friday 15 October. What day of the week will it be 1 week from today?
items.e: 1 week later is 7 days later. It is always the same day of the week: Friday 22 October.

items.q: Today is Wednesday 9 June. What is the date of the next Monday?
items.e: Go forward from the box to the next date in the Mon column: 14 June. (7 June was the Monday that has gone. 13 June is a Sunday.)

items.q: Today is Wednesday 9 June. What is the date of the next Tuesday?
items.e: Go forward from the box to the next date in the Tue column: 15 June. (8 June was last Tuesday. 22 June is the Tuesday after that.)

items.q: Today is Friday 15 October. What is the date of the next Monday?
items.e: Go forward to the next date in the Mon column: 18 October. (11 October was last Monday.)

items.q: Today is Friday 15 October. What is the date of the next Tuesday?
items.e: Go forward to the next date in the Tue column: 19 October. (12 October was last Tuesday.)

items.q: Today is Friday 15 October. The class goes to the library every Thursday. What is the date of the next library day?
items.e: Go forward to the next date in the Thu column: 21 October. (14 October was yesterday, so that library day has gone.)

items.q: Today is Wednesday 9 June. What was the date 1 week ago?
items.e: 1 week ago is 7 days back: 9 − 7 = 2. Go straight up one row: 2 June. (16 June is 1 week from now, not 1 week ago.)

items.q: Today is Friday 15 October. What was the date last Wednesday?
items.e: Go back to the Wed column in this row: 13 October. (20 October is next Wednesday.)

items.q: Today is Wednesday 9 June. What is the date 5 days after today?
items.e: 9 + 5 = 14 June. Count the jumps: 10, 11, 12, 13, 14. (13 June counts today as day 1.)

items.q: Today is Wednesday 9 June. What was the date 4 days before today?
items.e: 9 − 4 = 5 June. Count back: 8, 7, 6, 5. (6 June counts today as one of the days. 13 June is 4 days after.)

items.q: Today is Wednesday 9 June. What is the date 2 weeks from today?
items.e: 2 weeks = 14 days. 9 + 14 = 23. Go straight down two rows: 23 June. (16 June is only 1 week. 11 June is 2 days, not 2 weeks.)

items.q: Today is Friday 15 October. What is the date 10 days from today?
items.e: 15 + 10 = 25 October. (24 October counts today as one of the 10 days. 5 October counts back.)

items.q: Today is Friday 15 October. What is the date 2 weeks from today?
items.e: 2 weeks = 14 days. 15 + 14 = 29. Go down two rows: 29 October. (22 October is only 1 week.)

items.q: Today is Tuesday. What day will it be in 7 days?
items.e: 7 days is 1 week. After 1 week it is the same day again: Tuesday. (Monday counts today as one of the 7 days.)

items.q: Today is Thursday 28 October. October has 31 days. What is the date of the next Monday?
items.e: Count on: Friday 29, Saturday 30, Sunday 31 October. October ends on the 31st, so Monday is 1 November. (There is no 32 October. 25 October was last Monday.)

items.q: Today is 3 September. How many days until sports day?
items.e: Count the jumps from 3 to 10. Do not count the start day. 10 − 3 = 7. (8 counts the start day as well. 13 adds the dates.)

items.q: Today is 6 September. How many days until Ava’s birthday?
items.e: Count the jumps from 6 to 15. Do not count the start day. 15 − 6 = 9. (10 counts the start day as well. 21 adds the dates.)

items.q: Today is 14 September. How many sleeps until Kai’s party?
items.e: Count the jumps from 14 to 18. Do not count the start day. 18 − 14 = 4. Each sleep is one night: 14, 15, 16, 17. (5 counts the start day as well. 32 adds the dates.)

items.q: Today is 1 February. How many days until school photos?
items.e: Count the jumps from 1 to 9. Do not count the start day. 9 − 1 = 8. (9 counts the start day as well. 10 adds the dates.)

items.q: Today is 1 September. How many days until the last day of term?
items.e: Count the jumps from 1 to 24. Do not count the start day. 24 − 1 = 23. (24 counts the start day as well. 25 adds the dates.)

items.q: Today is 8 November. How many days until the school concert?
items.e: Count the jumps from 8 to 26. Do not count the start day. 26 − 8 = 18. (19 counts the start day as well. 34 adds the dates.)

items.q: Today is 10 February. How many days until the athletics carnival?
items.e: Count the jumps from 10 to 25. Do not count the start day. 25 − 10 = 15. (16 counts the start day as well. 35 adds the dates.)

items.q: Today is 22 November. How many days until 30 November?
items.e: Count the jumps from 22 to 30. Do not count the start day. 30 − 22 = 8. (9 counts the start day as well. 52 adds the dates.)

items.q: Today is 2 November. How many weeks until the swimming carnival?
items.e: 16 is 2 rows straight below 2. Each row down is 1 week. 16 − 2 = 14 days = 2 weeks. (3 weeks counts the rows instead of the jumps. 14 is days, not weeks.)

items.q: How many days is it from Mia’s birthday to Jack’s birthday?
items.e: Count the jumps from 5 to 19. Do not count the start day. 19 − 5 = 14. That is 2 weeks: 19 is 2 rows below 5. (15 counts the start day as well. 24 adds the dates.)

items.q: A library book is due on 12 November. Noah returns it on 15 November. How many days late is it?
items.e: Count the jumps from 12 to 15. Do not count the start day. 15 − 12 = 3. The book was not late on the due day. (4 counts the start day as well. 27 adds the dates.)

items.q: Today is 15 February. How many days until the last day of February?
items.e: Count the jumps from 15 to 28. Do not count the start day. 28 − 15 = 13. February 2027 has 28 days. (14 counts the start day as well. 43 adds the dates.)

items.q: Today is 3 February. The school fete is in 2 weeks. What is the date of the fete?
items.e: 2 weeks = 14 days. 3 + 14 = 17. Go straight down two rows: 17 February. (16 February counts today as day 1. 10 February is only 1 week. 5 February is 2 days.)

items.q: Grace’s birthday is on 27 May. Today is 19 May. How many days until her birthday?
items.e: Count the jumps from 19 to 27. Do not count the start day. 27 − 19 = 8. (9 counts the start day as well. 46 adds the dates.)

items.q: The class plants seeds on 3 March. The first flower opens on 17 March. How many days does it take?
items.e: Count the jumps from 3 to 17. Do not count the start day. 17 − 3 = 14. That is 2 weeks. (15 counts the start day as well. 20 adds the dates.)

items.q: Kai’s cousin comes to stay on 20 April and goes home on 27 April. How many nights does she stay?
items.e: Count the jumps from 20 to 27. Do not count the start day. 27 − 20 = 7. One night for each jump. That is 1 week. (8 counts the start day as well. 47 adds the dates.)

items.q: Today is 29 June. June has 30 days. The school holidays start on 3 July. How many days until the holidays?
items.e: Count the jumps: 29 June to 30 June is 1. 30 June to 3 July is 3 more (1, 2, 3 July). 1 + 3 = 4 days. (5 counts today as well. 26 is 29 − 3.)

items.q: Isla’s family goes camping on 15 March. They stay 3 nights. What date do they come home?
items.e: One night for each jump: 15 to 16, 16 to 17, 17 to 18. 15 + 3 = 18 March. (17 March counts the first day as one of the nights. 12 March counts back.)

items.q: Liam plants a bean seed on 7 June. It sprouts 10 days later. On what date does it sprout?
items.e: 7 + 10 = 17 June. (16 June counts 7 June as one of the 10 days. 10 June uses the 10 as a date.)

items.q: Today is 12 August. Book Week is in 2 weeks. What date is that?
items.e: 2 weeks = 14 days. 12 + 14 = 26 August. (19 August is only 1 week. 14 August is 2 days.)

sets.title: Seasons in Australia and school holidays

items.q: How many seasons are in a year?
items.e: Summer, autumn, winter and spring: 4 seasons. (12 is the number of months.)

items.q: How many months are in each season?
items.e: 12 months shared into 4 seasons is 3 each. Each season has 3 months.

items.q: In Australia, which season is January?
items.e: In Australia, summer is December, January and February. January is summer. (It is winter in January in countries like England and the USA, not in Australia.)

items.q: In Australia, which season is July?
items.e: In Australia, winter is June, July and August. July is winter. (Countries in the north of the world have summer in July.)

items.q: Which season comes after summer?
items.e: The seasons go summer, autumn, winter, spring, and then summer again. (Spring comes before summer.)

items.q: Which season is missing?
items.e: The seasons go summer, autumn, winter, spring. September, October and November are spring.

items.q: Which month is missing?
items.e: Winter is Jun, Jul, Aug. The missing month is July. (January is in summer.)

items.q: Christmas Day is on 25 December. Which season is that in Australia?
items.e: December is in summer in Australia, so Christmas is in summer. Many families go to the beach. (Christmas is in winter in England, not here.)

items.q: Which months are summer in Australia?
items.e: In Australia it is hot in December, January and February. That is summer. (June, July and August is summer in the north of the world, but winter here.)

items.q: Which months are winter in Australia?
items.e: In Australia it is cold in June, July and August. That is winter.

items.q: Anzac Day is on 25 April. Which season is that in Australia?
items.e: Autumn is March, April and May. So 25 April is in autumn. (Spring is in the north of the world in April, not in Australia.)

items.q: Cooper’s birthday is in October. Which season is that in Australia?
items.e: Spring is September, October and November. So October is in spring. (October is autumn in England and the USA.)

items.q: It is winter in Australia. Which month could it be?
items.e: Winter is June, July and August. (February and December are summer. May is autumn.)

items.q: Ruby’s birthday is in summer. Which month could it be?
items.e: Summer in Australia is December, January and February. (July is winter here.)

items.q: Matilda visits Hobart in July. What will the weather be like?
items.e: July is winter in Australia, so Hobart will be cold. Pack a warm jacket!

items.q: In Australia, the long summer holidays are in which months?
items.e: The long holidays are in summer, at the end of one school year and the start of the next: December and January. (June and July is the long summer break in the north of the world.)

items.q: How many school terms are in a year in Australian schools?
items.e: Australian schools have 4 terms a year, with holidays between them.

items.q: The winter holidays are 2 weeks long. How many days is that?
items.e: 1 week = 7 days. 7 + 7 = 14 days. (10 is the school days in 2 weeks, but holidays count every day.)

items.q: The winter holidays start on Saturday 3 July. School goes back on Monday 19 July. How many days is that?
items.e: Count the jumps from 3 to 19. 19 − 3 = 16 days. (17 counts the start day as well. 22 adds the dates.)

items.q: Today is 18 December. How many sleeps until Christmas Day?
items.e: 25 is straight below 18, so it is 1 week. 25 − 18 = 7 sleeps. (8 counts today as well. 43 adds the dates.)
